summary: Solver configuration container: objective, constraint, routing, grouping, webhook. All optional.
range: Object with optional sub-objects. Omitting options uses solver defaults.
businessRules: options defines: It represents the set of options that can be used to configure optimization algorithms so that the solver provides a solution that meets the desired business objectives.
Must stay consistent with: options.objective, options.constraint, options.routing. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: omit options entirely -> defaults (travel_cost=duration, mode=car).
